title: Tax Exemption for Vehicle License Fee When Relatives Within Second Degree of Kinship Share Household Registration with Disabled Person
summary: The Ministry of Finance has issued an interpretation order effective January 30, stating that vehicles owned by relatives within the second degree of kinship of a person with a disability, and registered at the same household address as the disabled person (who lacks a driver’s license due to their condition), are exempt from vehicle license tax if the vehicle is used by the disabled person. This policy aims to reduce financial burdens on families supporting disabled members.
